mapper.select: select * from (select t.Sn_Id as SnId, t.P_Id as pid, t.Con_Id as conId, t.Sn_Code as snCode, t.Sn_No as snNo, t.Sn_Issuing_Unit_Id as snIssuingUnitId, t.Sn_Receiving_Unit_Id as snReceivingUnitId, t.Sn_Issue_Date as snIssueDate, t.Sn_Need_Reply as snNeedReply, t.Sn_Reply as snReply, t.Sn_Reply_Deadline as snReplyDeadline, t.Sn_Content as snContent, t.Sn_Reply_State as snReplyState, t.Sn_Create_Uid as snCreateUid, t.Sn_Create_Uname as snCreateUname, t.Sn_Create_Time as snCreateTime, t.Sn_State as snState, t.Sn_State_Time as snStateTime, t1.p_Name as pname, t2.Con_Name as conName, t.Sn_Receiving_Unit_Name as snReceivingUnitName, t.Sn_Issuing_Unit_Name as snIssuingUnitName, t.Te_Id as teId from Con_Sup_Notice t left join Pre_Project t1 on t1.p_id = t.P_id left join Con_Contract t2 on t2.Con_Id = t.Con_Id LEFT JOIN Pre_Project mn ON mn.p_id = t.P_id ${authSql} ) c ${ew.customSqlSegment}
